description: atlasstamping.com Atlas Stamping Manufacturing Corp. is a US metal stamping company founded in 1971 in Richardson, Texas, producing precision stamped parts for automotive, aerospace, electronics, medical and industrial customers. With around 50 to 200 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it operates a full-service plant offering progressive and transfer die stamping, deep draw, forming, welding and assembly. Its own tool and die shop designs and maintains all stamping dies in-house, giving full control over quality and lead times. Press capabilities range from 30 to 400 tons handling materials from thin foil to quarter-inch thick steel, aluminum and specialty alloys. The company has served the Dallas-Fort Worth industrial market for 54 years with ISO 9001 quality systems and PPAP compliance for OEM clients.

epmmop.quito.gob.ec EPMMOP is the Metropolitan Public Company of Mobility and Public Works of Quito, Ecuador, responsible for urban transportation infrastructure and public works across the capital district of 2.7 million people. It manages the city's integrated transport system including the new Quito Metro, launched in December 2023 as Ecuador's first subway line with 22.4 kilometers and 15 stations. The agency also operates the TelefériQo cable car, one of the highest in the world, plus trolleybus, BRT and cable car systems under the SITM integrated transit framework. It builds and maintains roads, bridges, sidewalks, drainage and one of Latin America's largest cycling networks. The company works within Quito's UNESCO World Heritage context, requiring unique engineering solutions for the historic center.

pureperfection.com Pure Perfection GmbH is a German live communication agency founded in 2008 in Wiesbaden, ranked number one in the 2026 BlachReport German Event Creativity Ranking ahead of insglück and Vok Dams. With 72 to 80 employees across offices in Wiesbaden, Berlin, Düsseldorf and Florida, it delivered 133 events in 2025, with 90 of them abroad including Shanghai, Miami and Singapore. Led by co-founders Jan Rogozinski and Kim Meisinger, the agency works through three units: Pure Live for events, Pure Space for brand spaces and architecture, and Pure Content for storytelling and PR. Major clients include Audi, ŠKODA, L'Oréal, Bentley and Nestlé, with pharma being its largest vertical at 90 events per year. Revenue peaked at 26.4 million euro in 2023 and the agency won 60 MUSE Creative Awards in 2026 alone.

belmontresorts.com Belmont Resorts is a small boutique hotel in McLeodganj, Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, operating as Hotel Satovari Pride on the Strawberry Hills with panoramic views of the snow-capped Dhauladhar mountains. It has just 14 rooms across four categories from Deluxe to Premium Gold corner suites with private balconies, mini-fridges and sunrise-sunset views from both sides. Positioned as a value-for-money alternative next to ITC Hotels and Lemon Tree, it offers a pure vegetarian restaurant with Jain cuisine, 24/7 power backup, fast WiFi and free parking. The hotel caters to relaxation, spiritual tourism, trekking and long-term workation stays with tour packages to Khajjiar and Dalhousie.

softwareone.com SoftwareOne Turkiye is the Turkish arm of SoftwareOne Holding AG, a Swiss-listed global software and cloud solutions provider that merged with Crayon to form a 13,000 person company operating in over 70 countries. Based in Ataşehir, Istanbul and active since 2019, it employs around 40 to 60 people and works with 100 percent of Turkey's top 50 companies and 80 percent of the top 500. Services span software licensing advisory for Microsoft, IBM and Oracle, cloud migration across Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, AI and FinOps. In December 2024 SoftwareOne AG acquired full ownership of the Turkish entity, approved by the Turkish Competition Authority. Led by Managing Director Doğa Pekdemir and CFO Hakan Keriş, it has delivered projects for Turkish Airlines, TAV Airports, Coca-Cola and Vakıf Katılım. Key strengths are its unmatched enterprise market coverage in Turkey and full access to the global SoftwareOne and Crayon ecosystem.

farmacias911.com.ec Gettareq S.A., known as Farmacias 911, is a major Ecuadorian pharmaceutical company founded in 2013 in Guayaquil, combining retail pharmacy, wholesale distribution, OEM manufacturing and medical consulting across the whole country. The group operates six brands including Farmacias 911 retail, ACOSAR wholesale distribution, Galenic for private label manufacturing, One Laboratory for quality testing and Conseplus for consulting. It has grown from 11 to 500 employees with a 166 percent increase in headcount, working with global pharmaceutical giants like Abbott, Bayer, Bristol Myers Squibb, Takeda and Roche. Led by founder and CEO Marlon Morillo, the company hosted Ecuador's largest pharmaceutical convention in 2025 alongside APESFA. Its vertical integration from import and production to retail and lab testing is unique in the Ecuadorian market.

sanirent.com.mx Grupo Sanirent is a 100 percent Mexican company founded in 1983 in Mexico City, the national leader in portable toilet rental, mobile offices, septic services and waste management. With 178 employees and operations in all 32 Mexican states, it serves everything from private events and luxury weddings to massive construction sites and industrial operations. Its business lines include standard and VIP portable toilets, camper-style luxury stations, mobile office rentals, industrial drain cleaning with specialized vactor and guzzler trucks, and full waste collection including hazardous and bio-infectious materials. The company holds ISO 9001 certification and has won 53 government contracts with major institutions like IMSS, CFE, CAPUFE and the National Culture Secretariat. Its premium Eventos Especiales division provides luxury sanitary facilities for high-end events across the country. Key strengths are 43 years of experience, full national coverage, diversified service.

starimagesouthlake.com StarImage Dental Boutique & Oral Surgery is a premium dental practice in Southlake, Texas, opened in January 2021 as the second location of StarImage Dentistry founded by Dr. James Green in Wichita Falls over 25 years ago. Led by Dr. Green, oral surgeon Dr. Dustin Van Tassell and Dr. Susan Millner, it offers cosmetic and reconstructive dentistry, dental implants, full mouth rehabilitation, oral surgery, TMJ treatment and sleep apnea care all under one roof. The clinic is one of the most technologically advanced dental offices in the US, equipped with Planmeca ProMax 3D CBCT imaging, MLS laser therapy, VELscope cancer screening and CT-guided implant surgery. Both lead doctors hold Fellow status at the Las Vegas Institute for Advanced Dental Studies, and the practice maintains a perfect 5.0 rating across 50 plus reviews. Its dedicated TMJ and Sleep Center provides a high-margin specialization in jaw disorders and obstructive sleep apnea.

wika-beton.co.id WIKA Beton (PT Wijaya Karya Beton Tbk) is Indonesia's largest precast and prestressed concrete manufacturer, founded in 1997 and listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange since 2014 as part of state-owned Wijaya Karya group. It operates over 20 production plants across Indonesia from Java to Papua, producing more than 189 types of concrete products including bridge girders, piles, culverts and railway sleepers. Revenue is estimated at around 5.3 trillion rupiah with a market cap of 1.9 trillion, offering a 3.5 percent dividend yield and trading well below book value. The company is a primary supplier for Indonesia's massive infrastructure boom including toll roads, the Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway and new port construction. Led as a state-owned enterprise, it benefits from priority access to government contracts and a unique nationwide plant network.

incomelec.com Incomelec is a Colombian company founded in 2006 in Bogota, the Latin American leader in pedestrian, vehicle and passenger access control including turnstiles and automated barriers. With 52 employees and operations in 14 countries, it has installed equipment in over 20 airports, 90 parking facilities and 250 buildings, handling more than 85 percent of Colombia's toll booth systems. Its flagship product is BIOMIG, an automated migration control system used at El Dorado and Medellin airports with iris scanning and passport verification. It is the exclusive regional partner of Automatic Systems from the Bollore Group and the only distributor worldwide that locally assembles TR-490 and TR-491 turnstile lines. Led by CEO Kris De Sutter Gomez, it serves Metro de Medellin, TransMilenio and BD Bacata, Colombia's tallest building.

epichealth.com.au Epic Health is an Australian medical group founded in 2001 in Melbourne, running multiple brands including Epic Medical general practice, Epic Youth Health, Epic Skin Health and Alevia Medical Weight Loss. Its fastest-growing division is Alevia, offering doctor-supervised weight loss programs using GLP-1 medications like Mounjaro and Ozempic across four clinics plus telehealth Australia-wide. The group combines traditional family medicine with niche verticals like dermatology, adolescent health and aesthetic medicine under one team-based model. Led by medical director Dr. Neeraj Mahindra, it serves patients nationally through Medicare-compatible telehealth with instant rebates and a dedicated digital app. Key strengths are 24 years of operation, a debt-free financial position and multi-brand diversification into high-demand health niches. The company is well positioned in Australia's booming medical weight loss and telehealth markets.

surexport.es Surexport is the largest independent berry producer in Europe, founded in 1994 in Huelva, Spain, growing strawberries, raspberries, blueberries and blackberries across Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Morocco and Kenya. Owned since 2020 by Alantra Private Equity, the group is valued at around 600 million euros with revenue approaching 400 million and over 2500 employees. Its competitive edge is exclusive berry varieties developed with US genetics partner Plant Sciences since 2007, sold under the Doñarosa, Berry Sensations and Fruhi brands. Major clients include Tesco, Lidl, Mercadona and Sainsbury's, with 80 percent of revenue from exports to Northern Europe. The company invested 200 million euros in acquisitions and secured a 250 million euro loan in 2025.

aslinsaat.com.tr ASL İnsaat is a Turkish construction company based in Istanbul, operating in civil and industrial building contracting both domestically and internationally. It provides full-cycle services including design, general contracting and project management for residential, commercial and industrial projects. The company is privately held with estimated staffing of several hundred employees scaling with active construction sites. Turkey is the world's second largest market for international construction contractors, and ASL operates within this competitive ecosystem. Key sectors are residential complexes, shopping centers, hotels, factories and infrastructure. Typical strengths of Turkish contractors like ASL are cost competitiveness, speed of delivery and experience in challenging geographies across the Middle East, Africa and Central Asia.

vietnamairlines.com Revenue $4.4 Billion Vietnam Airlines is the national flag carrier of Vietnam, founded in 1956 and listed as HVN, with hubs in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City and about 86 percent state ownership together with ANA Holdings as strategic investor. It is a SkyTeam member operating 103 aircraft including Airbus A350s and Boeing 787 Dreamliners across 113 routes to 39 international destinations in 22 countries. In 2025 it posted record results with consolidated and net profit of 290 million dollars, carrying 25.6 million passengers. In February 2026 it finalized an order for 50 Boeing 737 MAX 8 jets worth about 10 billion dollars. The group includes Pacific Airlines, VASCO, VAECO maintenance and SKYPEC fuel units. Its target is to become a five-star Skytrax airline and the number two carrier in Southeast Asia by 2030.

nwmicro.com Northwest Micro Systems, formally Northwest Micro Inc., is a private IT services and software company founded in 1998 in Atlanta, Georgia, serving small businesses with managed IT, cloud backup, email, CRM and custom .NET development. Led by founder and owner Leo Zhadanovsky, it has around 11 employees and steady revenue of roughly 5 million dollars. Its unique model offers affordable one-time products like the One 2 One email server and Speed To Success CRM for about 100 dollars with lifetime updates and support. The company positions itself as the anti-corporate alternative to Oracle and Microsoft, focused on keeping small business clients for life. Core strengths are 28 years of market presence, a loyal SMB client base and a low-overhead operation. Its tech stack centers on Microsoft 365, SQL Server and .NET with a mix of SaaS and on-premise tools.

serit.no Serit CC, formally C.C. Solution AS, is a Norwegian IT services company founded in 2007 in Bergen, providing cloud, cybersecurity, managed IT, Microsoft 365 and AI automation to small and medium businesses. It has 6 employees and annual revenue of around 17 million Norwegian kroner, and since June 2025 it is part of Serit, one of Norway's largest independent IT groups with 27 offices and over 200 specialists. The company holds Helsenett certification for healthcare clients and runs its own Norwegian data center, keeping all data inside the country. It is led by founder and CEO Christopher Andreas Namtvedt, a former NATO systems administrator, together with CTO Ole Erik Skare who has been with the firm for 17 years. Core strengths are deep Bergen market knowledge combined with the national scale of Serit group partnerships with Microsoft, Fortinet, Dell and Lenovo. A newer focus is secure AI adoption and workflow automation for business clients.

zehren.com Zehren and Associates Zehren & Associates is an architecture and design firm founded in 1983 in Avon, Colorado, specializing in resort and mountain architecture with a second office in Santa Barbara, California. Led by founder Jack Zehren, a West Point graduate, the firm has about 37 employees and revenue of roughly 5 million dollars. It offers a full package of architecture, master planning, interior design and landscape architecture, known for projects like The 10th restaurant on Vail Mountain and The Blake hotel at Taos Ski Valley, voted the best ski hotel in North America. The firm designed the Beaver Creek master plan, winner of the Snow Country Best Resort award, and has worked in over 9 countries including Argentina, Korea and Mexico. Key strengths are 43 years of niche expertise and long-term partnerships with Vail Resorts and East West Partners.

pac.se PAC Group is a Swedish power plant automation company founded in 1979 in Stockholm, delivering control systems, simulation and optimization solutions for thermal, hydro, nuclear and renewable power plants. It has completed over 600 projects on more than 100 power plants across 50 countries with a combined capacity exceeding 110 gigawatts. Its product portfolio includes PAC Control, PAC-Sim full scope simulators, PAC-Balance and the ARTOCloud optimization platform, plus engineering, commissioning and cybersecurity services. The company is independent from major DCS vendors like Siemens and Emerson, giving it flexibility to integrate any technology. Led by CEO Mikael Andersson, many engineers have been with PAC for 20 to 34 years, ensuring deep institutional expertise. New directions include hydrogen power plants, battery energy storage, hybrid plant control and digital twin solutions.

unitedrolls.com United Rolls United Rolls Inc. is a US mill roll manufacturer founded in 1898 in Canton, Ohio, producing horizontally spun cast iron and steel rolls for hot strip, cold strip, plate and roughing mills worldwide. It is a subsidiary of WHEMCO and Park Corporation, employing around 64 to 110 people and generating estimated revenue of 10 to 20 million dollars. Its plant pours, heat treats, grinds and tests rolls under one roof with a capacity of 18,000 tons per year and rolls up to 66 tons. The company is known for its patented Synergy line, including Synergy 100 high-speed steel rolls and UR2-EC niobium carbide iron rolls that extend mill campaign life. Led by President Robert Feielin since 2024, it is part of WHEMCO, the only US maker of all roll types for flat rolling, with sales offices in Berlin and Sheffield. Key strengths are 128 years of heritage and full vertical integration.

mks.dk Marie Kruses Skole is a private school in Farum, Denmark, founded in 1869 by education pioneer Marie Kruse, offering a full track from kindergarten through gymnasium STX to about 1100 students. It is the only free primary school and the only gymnasium in Furesø Kommune, employing 107 people and led by rektor Carsten Gade. The school runs 8 gymnasium study lines including Biotek, Mat-Fys, sports, business, super languages and music, plus unique programs like Kruse Elitesport and diving. Revenue in 2024 reached 109.5 million Danish kroner with a 1.4 million profit, backed by 68 percent state subsidy and a stable surplus for 5 straight years. Tuition is 2190 kroner per month with financial aid available, and it attracts over 1100 students on its waiting list. Its key strengths are 157 years of heritage, top national exam results and free admissions independent of municipal student distribution rules.

spontinimilano.com Spontini is a Milanese pizza by the slice chain founded in 1953, now run by the third generation of the Innocenti family with Massimo Innocenti as CEO and his son Andrea leading operations. The group runs about 27 stores in Milan and 15 more across 10 countries including Japan, Korea, Qatar and Saudi Arabia, mostly through franchising with partners like M.H. Alshaya. It serves around 2.4 million pizza slices a year using an unchanged 1953 recipe with 100 percent Italian ingredients like Molini Certosa flour and Rodolfi tomatoes. Revenue has grown to roughly 30 million euro with over 800 employees, driven by expansion into travel locations like Milan Central station and Malpensa airport. In 2026 the brand entered retail with a frozen pizza line called Tonda 1953 produced with SanNico Food.
